tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch3:3-13↗ ex:invariant-metrics-lie-groups Write down an explicit formula for an arbitrary left-invariant metric on the Heisenberg group $H_n$ of Example 3.16(g) in terms of global coordinates $(x^1, \ldots , x^n, y^1, \ldots , y^n, z)$, and show that the group has no bi-invariant metrics. (Used on pp. 68, 72.) \end{exercise}
